Yes—arena configuration may vary, but only by selecting challenge-equivalent options, such as which fixture activates. That selection must use the seeded deterministic stream, so the same seed produces the same fight and golden tests remain reproducible. [yan-mo-main/CLAUDE.md:20]

This does not permit enemy randomness: enemy behavior, tells, and outcomes must remain pure functions of state. The enemy never rolls dice; only the environment may determine the room configuration. Fixed-timestep simulation, frame counters, ordered iteration, and the seeded stream are required; bare `random()`/`randi()` and wall-clock timing remain forbidden. [yan-mo-main/CLAUDE.md:20, 84; yan-mo-main/docs/dev-workflow.md:46]
